an8.30:1.1: 30 ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bhaggesu viharati suṃsumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye.
an8.30:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā anuruddho cetīsu viharati pācīnavaṃsadāye
an8.30:1.3: athakho āyasmato anuruddhassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
an8.30:1.10: paññavato ayaṃ dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo duppaññassāti.
an8.30:2.1: athakho bhagavā āyasmato anuruddhassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva bhaggesu suṃsumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye antarahito cetīsu pācīnavaṃsadāye āyasmato anuruddhassa sammukhe pāturahosi
an8.30:2.3: āyasmāpi kho anuruddho bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an8.30:2.4: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an8.30:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ anuruddha yantaṃ mahāpurisavitakkaṃ vitakkesi
an8.30:3.9: paññavato ayaṃ dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo duppaññassāti
an8.30:3.10: tenahi tvaṃ anuruddha imaṃ aṭṭhamaṃ mahāpurisavitakkaṃ vitakkehi
an8.30:3.11: nippapañcārāmassāyaṃ dhammo nippapañcaratino nāyaṃ dhammo papañcārāmassa papañcaratinoti.
an8.30:4.1: yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha ime aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi tato tvaṃ anuruddha yāvadeva ākaṅkhissasi vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharissasi.
an8.30:5.1: yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha ime aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi tato tvaṃ anuruddha yāvadeva ākaṅkhissasi vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharissasi.
an8.30:6.1: yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha ime aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi tato tvaṃ anuruddha yāvadeva ākaṅkhissasi pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharissasi sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedessasi yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharissasi.
an8.30:7.1: yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha ime aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi tato tvaṃ anuruddha yāva deva ākaṅkhissasi sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharissasi.
an8.30:8.1: yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha ime ca aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi imesañca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi akicchalābhī akasiralābhī tato tuyhaṃ anuruddha seyyathāpi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā nānārattānaṃ dussānaṃ dussakaraṇḍako pūro
an8.30:8.2: evameva te paṃsukūlacīvaraṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.
an8.30:9.1: yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha ime ca aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi imesañca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi akicchalābhī akasiralābhī tato tuyhaṃ anuruddha seyyathāpi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā sālīnaṃ odano vicitakāḷako anekasūpo anekabyañjano
an8.30:9.2: evameva te piṇḍiyālopabhojanaṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.
an8.30:10.1: yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha ime ca aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi imesañca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi akicchalābhī akasiralābhī tato tuyhaṃ anuruddha seyyathāpi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā kūṭāgāraṃ ullittāvalittaṃ nivātaṃ phusitaggaḷaṃ pihitavātapānaṃ
an8.30:10.2: evameva te rukkhamūlasenāsanaṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.
an8.30:11.1: yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha ime ca aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi imesañca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi akicchalābhī akasiralābhī tato tuyhaṃ anuruddha seyyathāpi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā pallaṅko goṇakatthato paṭikatthato paṭalikatthato kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇo sauttaracchado ubhatolohitakūpadhāno
an8.30:11.2: evameva te tiṇasantharakasayanāsanaṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.
an8.30:12.1: yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha ime ca aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi imesañca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi akicchalābhī akasiralābhī tato tuyhaṃ anuruddha seyyathāpi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā nānābhesajjāni seyyathīdaṃ sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ
an8.30:12.2: evameva te pūtimuttabhesajjaṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.
an8.30:12.3: tenahi tvaṃ anuruddha āyatikampi vassāvāsaṃ idheva cetīsu pācīnavaṃsadāye vihareyyāsīti.
an8.30:12.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā anuruddho bhagavato paccassosi.
an8.30:13.1: athakho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva cetīsu pācīnavaṃsadāye antarahito bhaggesu suṃsumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye pāturahosi
an8.30:13.4: aṭṭha vo bhikkhave mahāpurisavitakke desissāmi taṃ suṇātha …pe…

an8.30:13.11: samāhitassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo asamāhitassa
an8.30:13.12: paññavato ayaṃ bhikkhave dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo duppaññassa
an8.30:13.13: nippapañcārāmassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo nippapañcaratino nāyaṃ dhammo papañcārāmassa papañcaratino.
an8.30:14.1: appicchassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo mahicchassāti
an8.30:14.2: iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ
an8.30:14.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu appiccho samāno appicchoti maṃ jāneyyunti na icchati santuṭṭho samāno santuṭṭhoti maṃ jāneyyunti na icchati pavivitto samāno pavivittoti maṃ jāneyyunti na icchati āraddhaviriyo samāno āraddhaviriyoti maṃ jāneyyunti na icchati upaṭṭhitassati samāno upaṭṭhitassatīti maṃ jāneyyunti na icchati samāhito samāno samāhitoti maṃ jāneyyunti na icchati paññavā samāno paññavāti maṃ jāneyyunti na icchati nippapañcārāmo samāno nippapañcārāmoti maṃ jāneyyunti na icchati
an8.30:14.4: appicchassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo mahicchassāti

an8.30:16.3: tatra bhikkhu vivekaninnena cittena vivekapoṇena vivekapabbhārena vivekaṭṭhena nekkhammābhiratena aññadatthu uyyojanikapaṭisaṃyuttaṃyeva kathaṃ kattā hoti

an8.30:17.3: āraddhaviriyassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo kusītassāti

an8.30:22.1: athakho āyasmā anuruddho āyatikampi vassāvāsaṃ tattheva cetīsu pācīnavaṃsadāye vihāsi
an8.30:22.2: athakho āyasmā anuruddho eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā samma deva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
an8.30:22.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi
an8.30:22.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā anuruddho arahataṃ ahosi
an8.30:22.5: athakho āyasmā anuruddho arahattappatto tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imā gāthāyo abhāsi.
